text: {"lessons":["A gain feels good, but selling Stock B and Stock D should depend on their future risk and my portfolio goals—not the pleasure of locking in profit.","My average cost is not a reason to cling to a losing position or sell a winning one; I should judge each holding on its merits from today onward.","These few monthly gains and losses do not reveal a reliable price pattern, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and trade only when my plan calls for it."]}
